mission.title: zot: [Feat]: Option to skip upstream sync for tags already present locally with onDemand: true
mission.description: [Feat]: Option to skip upstream sync for tags already present locally with onDemand: true. Community-requested feature.

steps.title: Check current zot deployment
steps.description:
Verify your zot version and configuration:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n zot -l app.kubernetes.io/name=zot
helm list -n zot 2>/dev/null || echo "Not installed via Helm"
```
This feature requires a working zot installation.

steps.title: Review zot configuration
steps.description:
Inspect the relevant zot configuration:
```bash
kubectl get all -n zot -l app.kubernetes.io/name=zot
kubectl get configmap -n zot -l app.kubernetes.io/part-of=zot
```
### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.

I use zot as a pull-through cache on embedded servers with intermittent connectivity, low bandwidth, and limited disk space.

steps.title: Apply the fix for [Feat]: Option to skip upstream sync for tags already…
Upgrade zot to include the fix
steps.description:
If the fix is included in a newer release, upgrade zot:
```bash
helm repo update
helm upgrade zot zot/zot --namespace zot
```
Verify the upgrade:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n zot
helm list -n zot
```

steps.title: Verify the feature works
steps.description:
Test that the new capability is working as expected:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n zot -l app.kubernetes.io/name=zot
kubectl get events -n zot --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' | tail -10
```
Confirm the feature described in "[Feat]: Option to skip upstream sync for tags already…" is functioning correctly.

resolution.summary: With `onDemand`, zot checks a stored tag against upstream on each request. For tags that don't change once pushed, such as release versions, this check only adds latency, and the request fails or waits when the upstream is slow or unreachable.
codeSnippets:
upstream                     tag                     result
answers 503                  1.38 (synced)           200 in 1 ms, 0 upstream requests
answers 503                  1.36 (copied in)        200 in 1 ms, 0 upstream requests
accepts, never answers       1.38, 1.36              200 in 1 ms
same, downstream restarted   1.38, 1.36              200 in 1 ms
back up                      1.37 (not stored)       200 (synced)

prerequisites.description: A running Kubernetes cluster with zot installed or the issue environment reproducible.
